name: Raffles Sentosa Singapore
insider_take: This ultra-luxe beachfront sanctuary sits on 14 acres of pristine coastline, where colonial elegance meets tropical paradise on Singapore's resort island playground.
whats_special: The only all-villa resort in Singapore features just 60 spacious villas, each with private pools and beach or garden views. As part of the legendary Raffles legacy, it maintains the brand's signature butler service while offering direct access to Siloso Beach's powdery white sands—a rarity in urban Singapore.
pro_tip: Book the Sunset Villa for unobstructed ocean views and prime position for the nightly crane dance at nearby Crane Dance show—visible from your private terrace without the crowds.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Long Bar serves the original Singapore Sling in a beachfront setting, while Sentosa's attractions including Universal Studios, S.E.A. Aquarium, and the famous Merlion statue are all within minutes. The complimentary beach club access includes water sports and sunset yoga sessions.
pros: All-Villa Resort — Every accommodation is a private pool villa, delivering an elevated sense of exclusivity and space rarely found in Singapore.
Iconic Raffles Legacy — Guests enjoy the legendary Raffles hallmark of impeccable, personalized white-glove service with a warm, modern touch.
Beachfront Tropical Escape — Nestled along Siloso Point on Sentosa Island, the resort offers lush rainforest surroundings and rare direct beach access.
World-Class Dining & Spa — Multiple acclaimed dining venues and the Raffles Spa provide an indulgent, resort-within-a-resort wellness experience.
Privileged Accor HERA Benefits — Booking through WhataHotel! unlocks exclusive Accor HERA program perks including bonus points, upgrades, and tailored amenities.
cons: Secluded Island Location — Situated on Sentosa Island, guests may find it less convenient for spontaneous access to Singapore's main city centre.
Ultra-Luxury Price Point — The all-villa format and premium positioning place this resort at the higher end of Singapore's luxury accommodation spectrum.
